title: Mehbooba slams NC govt over exam irregularities, says students’ future at risk

ai.summary: PDP president Mehbooba Mufti criticized the National Conference-led government for alleged exam irregularities, warning that repeated controversies threaten students' futures in Jammu and Kashmir.

facts.claim: Mehbooba Mufti criticised the National Conference-led government over alleged examination irregularities
facts.quote: Srinagar, Nov 21: Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) president Mehbooba Mufti on Saturday criticised the National Conference-led government over alleged examination irregularities, saying repeated controversies were jeopardising the future of students in Jammu and Kashmir.

facts.claim: Mehbooba Mufti warned that repeated controversies were jeopardising the future of students in Jammu and Kashmir
facts.quote: Srinagar, Nov 21: Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) president Mehbooba Mufti on Saturday criticised the National Conference-led government over alleged examination irregularities, saying repeated controversies were jeopardising the future of students in Jammu and Kashmir.

facts.claim: Mehbooba Mufti questioned the government’s ability to ensure fair and transparent examinations
facts.quote: Speaking to reporters in Srinagar, Mehbooba questioned the government’s ability to ensure fair and transparent examinations.

facts.claim: Mehbooba Mufti said students work hard throughout their lives and pay hefty fees, yet continue to face injustice due to alleged irregularities in the examination system
facts.quote: She said students work hard throughout their lives and pay hefty fees, yet continue to face injustice due to alleged irregularities in the examination system.

facts.claim: Mehbooba Mufti described the situation as 'scam upon scam, scam upon scam' with no change under the National Conference government
facts.quote: ‘Scam upon scam, scam upon scam. There has been no change. If it happened during Governor’s rule, it is happening under today’s National Conference government as well,’ she said.

facts.claim: Mehbooba Mufti mentioned that a minister in Delhi had been dropped following public outrage over the NEET controversy
facts.quote: Referring to the NEET controversy, Mehbooba said a minister in Delhi had been dropped following public outrage, while the issue in Jammu and Kashmir appeared to be receiving little attention.

facts.claim: Mehbooba Mufti demanded a thorough probe into alleged examination irregularities
facts.quote: Demanding a thorough probe, the PDP chief called for identifying the alleged syndicate behind the examination irregularities before taking any action.

facts.claim: Mehbooba Mufti said the government should not play with the future of children
facts.quote: ‘This is a very serious matter. The government should not play with the future of our children. Whatever mistakes have taken place should be investigated,’ she said.

ai.background_note: The J&K statehood movement has been protesting for the Centre to restore statehood since 2019, but this article focuses on examination irregularities rather than statehood.
